title: Metric (alias of sf-tile-metric)
summary: The dated alias of SIMAI Framework's metric tile sf-tile-metric until 2027-01-01 (decision C168): the same settings, the chart slot for an sf-chart-sparkline, the former data-state, event name and public variables mapped onto the tile. Write <sf-tile-metric> for new pages.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: What the number is, in a few words: the tile's accessible name. sf-tile-metric's label: without it the tile is named «Показатель».

value.description: The number. Unset, the tile says «—». sf-tile-metric's value.

format.description: sf-tile-metric's format: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<Intl unit>, in the page's language; money is whole unless a precision word is given (currency-RUB decimal-2). The change and the limit are written the same way.

previous.description: The value of the previous period; the change is worked out from it when delta is not given. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

delta.description: The change itself, when the page has it; it wins over previous. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

delta-format.description: How the change is written: its share of the previous value, the difference in the value's format, or both. Without a previous value it is the difference. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

period-text.description: What the change is against, after it: «к прошлой неделе». The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

better.description: Whether a rise is good: up for sales, down for server load or errors, none when neither. The change's tone follows its meaning, not its sign. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

max.description: A limit: the tile shows «value of max» with a meter (storage, a licence, a quota). The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

limit-text.description: The words under the meter instead of «45 ГБ из 100 ГБ». The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

status.description: The page's statement about the number, in the shared status vocabulary: sf-tile-metric's status, a status icon of that tone before the hint. Thresholds are the page's (sf-tile-metric's warning-at and error-at).

hint.description: A short line beside the status. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

href.description: Makes the whole tile one link to this address. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

openable.description: Without href: makes the whole tile one button that sends open. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the value's text, the gaps. 1/2 for a dense row, 2 for a page's headline figure. The same setting of sf-tile-metric.

data-state.description: The former state setting, kept until 2027-01-01: loading is sf-tile-metric's loading (the label stays, each waiting line keeps its place, aria-busy); empty draws the tile without its value («—»); auto and ready follow the value. Write loading on sf-tile-metric instead.

sf-chart-metric-open.summary: A person pressed an openable tile (a click, Enter or Space): sf-tile-metric's open {id}, sent as sf-tile-metric-open and, until 2027-01-01, as sf-chart-metric-open with the same detail; the host opens the details.

accessibility.focus: None for a plain tile; one Tab stop for a link or a button tile.

ai_guidance.use_when: Do not use sf-chart-metric in new markup: it is the dated alias of SIMAI Framework's sf-tile-metric until 2027-01-01. Write <sf-tile-metric> with an sf-chart-sparkline in slot="chart".
do_not: Do not write sf-chart-metric in new pages; write sf-tile-metric
Do not listen for sf-chart-metric-open in new code; listen for sf-tile-metric-open
Do not infer a status from the value; give warning-at and error-at, or status with a hint
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-tile-metric label="Выручка за неделю" value="1250000" previous="1100000" format="currency-RUB"><sf-chart-sparkline slot="chart" label="Выручка по дням"></sf-chart-sparkline></sf-tile-metric>
